lines.zh: 有人在等我吗。羊圈早空了。
lines.en: Is anyone waiting? The pen is long empty.

lines.zh: 脚底下的草，全枯了。
lines.en: The grass under my feet is all dead.

lines.zh: 我的羊毛是一层菌毯。
lines.en: My fleece has become sculk.

lines.zh: 祭坛在后面，我的蹄子朝前。
lines.en: The altar is behind me; my hooves face forward.

lines.zh: 骨头响一声，我的羊毛抖一下。
lines.en: A bone clicks; my wool twitches.

lines.zh: 别回头，回头的羊会停住。
lines.en: Don't look back; sheep that look back stop.

lines.zh: 幽匿的影子，总比我快半步。
lines.en: The sculk shadow is always half a step ahead.

lines.zh: 月亮移一寸，我的蹄子移一寸。
lines.en: The moon moves an inch; my hooves move an inch.

lines.zh: 风吹开羊毛，里面是幽匿。
lines.en: The wind parts my wool; sculk lies beneath.

lines.zh: 数到第七步，我忘了在数什么。
lines.en: At the seventh step, I forget what I'm counting.

lines.zh: 白天太亮，我的羊毛变透明。
lines.en: Daylight is too bright; my wool goes thin.

lines.zh: 我啃过的草，会长出幽匿。
lines.en: The grass I graze grows back as sculk.

lines.zh: 符文还卡在我的蹄缝里。
lines.en: The rune is still wedged in my hoof.

lines.zh: 蹄子抬起来，又放回草里。
lines.en: I lift a hoof and set it back in the grass.

lines.zh: 羊毛还在，里面全变了。
lines.en: The wool stays — everything inside changed.

lines.zh: 羊毛底下，幽匿一直在爬。
lines.en: Under my wool, sculk keeps crawling.

lines.zh: 我的角弯了，羊毛也硬了。
lines.en: My horns are bent and my wool's gone stiff.

lines.zh: 生前我趴在这块石头上晒太阳。
lines.en: Alive, I sunned myself on this stone.

lines.zh: 有羊在叫吗。只有我。
lines.en: Is a sheep bleating? Only me.

lines.zh: 幽匿的毛，晒不暖。
lines.en: Sculk wool never warms up.

lines.zh: 我记得剪毛的剪刀，忘了名字。
lines.en: I remember the shears, but not my name.

lines.zh: 天亮了，我的羊毛还是一样灰。
lines.en: Let dawn come; my wool stays gray.

lines.zh: 你的热气，烫到我的羊毛了。
lines.en: Your warmth scalds my wool.

lines.zh: 别怕，我只想蹭蹭你的腿。
lines.en: Don't fear; I only want to nudge your leg.

lines.zh: 我的毛早就不是白的。
lines.en: My wool stopped being white long ago.

lines.zh: 别跑，我的四条腿比你熟路。
lines.en: Don't run; my four legs know the way better.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我羊毛上，是暖的。
lines.en: Your shadow on my wool feels warm.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛，能不能分我一只。
lines.en: Could you spare me one of your eyes?

lines.zh: 我的毛里，藏着孢子。
lines.en: Spores are hidden in my fleece.

lines.zh: 他们叫我幽匿绵羊，记住。
lines.en: They call me Sculk Sheep. Remember.

lines.zh: 我吃草，草也长成幽匿色。
lines.en: I graze, and the grass turns sculk-hued.

lines.zh: 活人，你的手还是热的。
lines.en: A living one, and your hands are still warm.

lines.zh: 你还挺有力气，我掉了一撮毛。
lines.en: You're strong; I lost a tuft of wool.

lines.zh: 这一下，我掉的毛都是蓝的。
lines.en: That blow, and the wool I shed is blue.

lines.zh: 咔哒，我的角裂了一道。
lines.en: Click; a crack runs through my horn.

lines.zh: 疼，羊毛底下的肉还会疼。
lines.en: It hurts; the flesh under my wool still hurts.

lines.zh: 退后，我的角还没断。
lines.en: Back off; my horns aren't broken.

lines.zh: 别打了，停下，毛都掉了。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; my wool is falling out.

lines.zh: 活着时剪毛更疼，现在只是麻。
lines.en: Shearing hurt more when alive; now it's only numb.

lines.zh: 前腿断了，我还有三条腿。
lines.en: My foreleg is broken; I still have three.

lines.zh: 别碰伤口，羊毛会粘你手上。
lines.en: Don't touch the wound; wool will stick to your hand.

lines.zh: 你的气味，我记在羊毛里了。
lines.en: I've kept your scent in my wool.

lines.zh: 腐肉比干草香，我自己也奇怪。
lines.en: Rotten meat smells better than hay; even I find it odd.

lines.zh: 我身上的羊毛，全是幽匿的蓝。
lines.en: My wool is all sculk blue.

lines.zh: 这身羊毛，已经硬成壳。
lines.en: This wool has hardened into shell.

lines.zh: 草没味道了，只剩你。
lines.en: The grass tastes of nothing — only you do.

lines.zh: 你手里那块骨头，给我啃。
lines.en: That bone in your hand, give it to me.

lines.zh: 羊毛下面是幽匿，不是肉。
lines.en: Sculk under the wool, not meat.

lines.zh: 金子在发光，我的羊毛也在。
lines.en: The gold glows, and so does my wool.

lines.zh: 那块肉还冒热气，放我槽里。
lines.en: That meat still steams; put it in my trough.

lines.zh: 我吃草，也吃靠近的人。
lines.en: I eat grass, and I eat those who come close.

lines.zh: 活物的气味太浓，我的草咽不下。
lines.en: The smell of the living is too strong; my grass won't go down.

lines.zh: 你心跳撞在我羊毛上，很响。
lines.en: Your heartbeat knocks on my wool, loud.

lines.zh: 对不起，我忘了羊不该道歉。
lines.en: Sorry; I forgot sheep shouldn't apologize.

lines.zh: 撞一下，幽匿渣从我背上掉。
lines.en: One bump and sculk crumbs fall off my back.

lines.zh: 我的羊毛，全是幽匿丝。
lines.en: My wool is all sculk thread.

lines.zh: 骨头响了一声，是我的。
lines.en: Something clicked, and it was my bone.

lines.zh: 活着的人真硬，我的头骨都麻了。
lines.en: Living ones are hard; my skull is numb.

lines.zh: 你太烫了，我的羊毛都卷了。
lines.en: You're so hot my wool curls.

lines.zh: 羊的叫声，变得很闷。
lines.en: My bleat has gone muffled.

lines.zh: 看路，你的膝盖撞上我的角。
lines.en: Watch the road; your knee met my horn.

lines.zh: 走开，我的羊毛里全是坟土。
lines.en: Move; my wool is full of grave soil.

lines.zh: 别看我，羊毛掉了一半。
lines.en: Don't look at me; half my wool's gone.

lines.zh: 我们站在幽匿里，就够了。
lines.en: Standing in the sculk is enough for us.

lines.zh: 我们一起，变成幽匿吧。
lines.en: Let us both become sculk.

lines.zh: 月亮照着我，我的羊毛不会变白。
lines.en: The moon watches; my wool won't turn white.

lines.zh: 我想蹭你，却只蹭下幽匿。
lines.en: I want to nuzzle you, but only sculk rubs off.

lines.zh: 下辈子，我早点回这片草场。
lines.en: Next life, I'll come back to this pasture early.

lines.zh: 算了，两只羊并排站着就好。
lines.en: Never mind; two sheep standing side by side is enough.

lines.zh: 想靠近你，怕羊毛掉一地。
lines.en: I want to come close, but fear shedding wool everywhere.

lines.zh: 我的毛硬成一片，剪不动。
lines.en: My wool hardened into one sheet.

lines.zh: 这副羊身，只生得出幽匿。
lines.en: This sheep body only births sculk.

lines.zh: 我的羊毛，全粘成一块。
lines.en: My wool has matted into one slab.

lines.zh: 嘴里总算叼到点东西。
lines.en: At last I have something in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这是剪羊毛的刀，我还认得。
lines.en: These are shears; I still know them.

lines.zh: 这符文不是我的，是祭坛的。
lines.en: This rune isn't mine; it belongs to the altar.

lines.zh: 我捡它做什么，又不能吃。
lines.en: Why pick it up? It isn't food.

lines.zh: 我叼着的东西，说不出是什么。
lines.en: I can't say what it is I'm carrying.

lines.zh: 带回羊圈，埋在槽底下。
lines.en: Take it to the pen and bury it under the trough.

lines.zh: 拿稳，掉了就沾上幽匿。
lines.en: Hold it steady; drop it and sculk clings.

lines.zh: 捡一件，往羊毛里塞一件。
lines.en: Pick one up, stuff one into my wool.

lines.zh: 这味道，像活人剪羊毛的手。
lines.en: This smells like living hands that sheared.

lines.zh: 你的味道很新鲜，草里没有过。
lines.en: Your scent is fresh; never in this grass before.

lines.zh: 你的热气，我从草里闻到了。
lines.en: I smell your warmth through the grass.

lines.zh: 你不该来这片被啃秃的草场。
lines.en: You shouldn't have come to this grazed-bare pasture.

lines.zh: 盯上了，我的角收不回来。
lines.en: Locked on; my horns won't pull back.

lines.zh: 我的羊毛，长成幽匿的样子。
lines.en: My wool has grown into sculk.

lines.zh: 谁先动，谁先变成幽匿。
lines.en: Whoever moves first becomes sculk first.

lines.zh: 别回头。已经来不及。
lines.en: Don't turn around. It's too late.

lines.zh: 不疼的，很快就完。
lines.en: It doesn't hurt. It'll be quick.

lines.zh: 我的毛变成了一丛菌。
lines.en: My wool has turned into a patch of fungus.

lines.zh: 四条腿追两条，只是时间问题。
lines.en: Four legs against two; it's only a matter of time.

lines.zh: 让你久等了，我啃完这片草。
lines.en: Sorry to keep you; I finished the grass.

lines.zh: 今晚的羊毛是热的。
lines.en: The wool is warm tonight.

lines.zh: 我不再吃草了。
lines.en: I don't eat grass anymore.

lines.zh: 跑吧，我的四条腿等着。
lines.en: Run; my four legs are waiting.

lines.zh: 草里就你一个在动。
lines.en: You're the only one moving in the grass.

lines.zh: 我们慢慢来，先绕这圈草。
lines.en: Let's take it slow; first circle this grass.

lines.zh: 羊毛里全是幽匿，我还是闻到你。
lines.en: My wool is all sculk, and I still smell you.

lines.zh: 别跑太快，我的腿不听话。
lines.en: Don't run too fast; my legs won't obey.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩在幽匿上，有声。
lines.en: Hooves on sculk make a sound.

lines.zh: 别躲进光里，我的羊毛怕亮。
lines.en: Don't hide in the light; my wool fears brightness.

lines.zh: 羊毛早被幽匿吃透了。
lines.en: The sculk has soaked through my wool.

lines.zh: 你跑吧，我的蹄子比你想的快。
lines.en: Run; my hooves are faster than you think.

lines.zh: 这片草场，我生前天天来。
lines.en: This pasture, I came every day while alive.

lines.zh: 追了这么远，毛都掉了。
lines.en: Chased this far — my wool's falling out.

lines.zh: 你越跑，我的肚子越空。
lines.en: The more you run, the emptier my belly.

lines.zh: 喘吧，我嚼着草等你。
lines.en: Pant; I'll chew grass and wait.

lines.zh: 前腿断了，我用三条腿追。
lines.en: My foreleg broke; I chase on three.

lines.zh: 我没有肺，追你也不喘。
lines.en: I have no lungs, yet I don't pant chasing you.

lines.zh: 站住，我的羊角已经低下了。
lines.en: Stop; my horns are already lowered.

lines.zh: 前面是石墙，我的蹄印到头了。
lines.en: A stone wall ahead; my hoofprints end here.

lines.zh: 等等我，我的蹄子陷进泥里了。
lines.en: Wait for me; my hooves sank in the mud.

lines.zh: 蹄印快踩到你的影子了。
lines.en: My hoofprints almost touch your shadow.

lines.zh: 你的影子拉长，我的角也跟长。
lines.en: Your shadow lengthens; my horns follow.

lines.zh: 二十点血，撞你五下。
lines.en: Twenty health, five points a hit.

lines.zh: 回头看看我，我的角在长。
lines.en: Look back at me; my horns are growing.

lines.zh: 羊毛里全是幽匿的味。
lines.en: My wool reeks of sculk.

lines.zh: 我这身羊毛，长满了幽匿。
lines.en: My fleece is overgrown with sculk.

lines.zh: 我的前蹄落下，别怪我没收力。
lines.en: My forehoof falls; don't blame me for not holding back.

lines.zh: 羊毛擦到你，差一点。
lines.en: My wool grazed you — so close.

lines.zh: 再来一下，羊毛还厚着。
lines.en: One more, the wool is still thick.

lines.zh: 我顶人的角还在。
lines.en: My headbutting horns remain.

lines.zh: 倒下吧，我的角已经顶到你胸口。
lines.en: Go down; my horns are at your chest.

lines.zh: 倒下轻点，别压坏这片草。
lines.en: Fall gently; don't crush this grass.

lines.zh: 剪我的毛，你就等着。
lines.en: Shear me and you'll see.

lines.zh: 别躲，站好，让我顶正。
lines.en: Don't dodge; stand still so I hit square.

lines.zh: 我力气不大，可羊角够尖。
lines.en: I'm not strong, but my horns are sharp enough.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，我的蹄子就进两步。
lines.en: You fall back a step; my hooves take two.

lines.zh: 这次羊角勾住你了。
lines.en: This time my horns hook you.

lines.zh: 你看，我这副羊身还能顶。
lines.en: See? This sheep body can still butt.

lines.zh: 这具羊身，只剩顶撞的用处。
lines.en: This sheep body is only good for ramming now.

lines.zh: 我顶你一下，毛都竖了。
lines.en: One headbutt and my wool stands.

lines.zh: 别叫，羊群会被你惊散。
lines.en: Don't cry out; you'll scatter the flock.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩下去，地都变蓝了。
lines.en: Where my hooves fall, the ground turns blue.

lines.zh: 羊毛底下一直是冷的。
lines.en: It has always been cold under this wool.

lines.zh: 羊毛里长出幽匿，天一黑就动。
lines.en: Sculk in the wool stirs when dark falls.

lines.zh: 这片天，我生前也看过。
lines.en: I saw this sky while alive too.

lines.zh: 活人别靠近，我的羊毛会扎人。
lines.en: Stay back, living one; my wool stings.

lines.zh: 羊毛卷着幽匿，扎人。
lines.en: Sculk in my wool prickles.

lines.zh: 咩一声，孢子就散出去。
lines.en: One bleat and the spores scatter.

lines.zh: 毛里发霉，我该往哪去。
lines.en: Mold in my wool — where do I go?

lines.zh: 我睡了多久，草都长高了。
lines.en: How long did I sleep? The grass grew tall.

lines.zh: 谁把我从羊毛里叫醒。
lines.en: Who woke me from the wool?

lines.zh: 祭坛又回来了，我的角先碰到它。
lines.en: The altar is back; my horns touch it first.

lines.zh: 土一松，我的蹄子先出来。
lines.en: The soil loosens; my hooves come out first.

lines.zh: 我不吃草了，只啃菌。
lines.en: I don't eat grass now, only fungus.

lines.zh: 这身羊毛又长回来了。
lines.en: This fleece has grown back again.

lines.zh: 四只蹄子踩在幽匿上。
lines.en: Four hooves stand on sculk.

lines.zh: 幽匿的羊，烧起来有股菌味。
lines.en: A sculk sheep burns with a fungal smell.

lines.zh: 腿一软，我塌成一堆。
lines.en: My legs gave out; I collapsed.

lines.zh: 幽匿羊毛吸水，我往下沉。
lines.en: My sculk wool soaks up water and I sink.

lines.zh: 我的羊毛硬得像苔藓。
lines.en: My wool is stiff as moss.

lines.zh: 箭扎进羊毛，拔不出来了。
lines.en: The arrow is stuck in my wool.

lines.zh: 光烧进羊毛，一直烧到骨头。
lines.en: Light burns through my wool to the bone.

lines.zh: 饿得连羊叫都发不出来。
lines.en: Too hungry even to bleat.

lines.zh: 幽匿的毛，导电。
lines.en: Sculk wool carries a charge.

lines.zh: 羊毛飘起来，我还在往下掉。
lines.en: My wool floats; I keep falling.
